Kayak Confidence Scale

Instructions:  Below are descriptions of how you feel in a kayak. Use the following scale to rate each.

Strongly Disagree	Disagree	Neutral	Agree	Strongly Agree
             1	    	      2 	 	     3 		    4 		           5

_____1. I feel steady in a kayak.

_____2. . I can roll a kayak back upright.

_____3. I did not used a spray deck on my first trip.

_____4. I enjoy paddling in waves.

After you have recoded the previous questions, add all of the numbers together to get your composite kayak confidance score.
